messages:
mira: Quick spike in the cost dashboard for model 'mistral-8x' this morning, looks like cache savings jumped negative (we're charging more than baseline).

noah: negative savings = we're attributing extra tokens somewhere. Any recent routing changes?

jorge: routing-v3 pushed yesterday included prefetch split and a new sessionization rule. might be related.

mira: attaching the overview chart: https://internal/charts/1761239999.png
I also ran a short query:
```
-- per-model token tally for last hour
select model, sum(total_tokens) as total, sum(prefetch_credits) as prefetch, sum(hotpath_credits) as hotpath
from token_ledger
where model like 'mistral-%'
group by model
order by total desc
```
returns: total=450k, prefetch=300k, hotpath=260k

noah: so prefetch+hotpath > total. duplicate crediting again.

jorge: new sessionization groups fetch+invoke under same session_id and we added both credits previously. We intended dedupe at billing but maybe the new session_id changed shape so dedupe filter missed them.

mira: Finance already raised tickets yesterday about "weird negative cache" for some tenants. We need quick mitigation and a proper fix.

noah: mitigation options: 1) UI change to show "gross vs net" (hide gross by default), 2) simple backend transform that collapses credits when session_id matches and timestamps within X ms, 3) telemetry and alerts only while we debug.

jorge: (2) seems reasonable and small: collapse credits where session_id and invocation_hash match, prefer highest origin priority (hotpath > prefetch). Implementation ~3-4hrs.

mira: any risk to quotas/limits if we collapse credits? Could double-count prevent throttles?

noah: quotas evaluate against raw token usage, not credits. credits are purely accounting; collapsing them won't affect throttles. But some of our analytics dashboards do assume credits sum == token counts for model-level attribution. We'll need to mark that view as "accounting-normalized" so people know.

jorge: I'll prototype backend dedupe and add a feature flag `accounting.dedupe.v1`. We can enable it for canary tenants only.

ci-bot: ci-bot: build passed for branch accounting/dedupe-v1 (job #842)

analytics-bot: analytics-bot: emitted new gauge cost.dup_credit_ratio=0.67 for model=mistral-8x, window=1h

mira: nice. can we also add an experimental UX toggle in the cost dashboard: dropdown -> [show net (deduped), show gross (raw credits)]. default = net. tooltip explains: "Net subtracts overlapping prefetch/hotpath credits assigned to the same invocation."

noah: +1. add a subtle banner "Experimental accounting normalization" when net is selected so customers know numbers changed.

jorge: backend will return both values in the new endpoint: payload will include total_tokens, credits_raw, credits_deduped. no breaking change, old endpoints untouched for now.

mira: timeline? Finance wants a mitigation in 24h.

jorge: I can get a canary rollout in ~8h (code + small migration). Need someone for QA to validate tenant sample.

noah: I'll do QA and sanity-check charts. ops, can you enable the flag for tenants: [42, 87] in staging?

ops: ops: flag enabled for tenants 42,87 in staging (accounting.dedupe.v1 = on)

mira: thanks. also let's add an alert if credits_raw - credits_deduped > 10% of total for any model for >15m. want to know if any other models are affected.

analytics-bot: analytics-bot: alert rule created: high_duplicate_credit_rate (threshold=0.10, window=15m)

mira: perfect. after canary we will run a backfill to recompute prior 7 days and include an FAQ entry in docs explaining prefetch vs hotpath and why net/gross differ.

jorge: will post PR link when ready.

mira: thanks team. keeping this thread for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
